title: World Cup 2026: Dembélé happy to play in third consecutive World Cup semi final
summary: After scoring a goal for Les Bleus against Morocco on Thursday, French striker Ousmane Dembélé shifted focus to the next match, which would be his third consecutive FIFAWorldCup semi final. The 2025 Ballon d'Or winner also had some words of praise for his captain and fellow goalscorer Kylian Mbappé ▶️
